polygon.style: stroke-width: 0.00; stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; fill: #0072B2; fill-opacity: 0.20;

g.text: g density with rug and normal
Solid line: posterior mean of the density of g. Band: pointwise 90% posterior interval. Dashed
line: normal distribution with its mean and standard deviation estimated by REML; the uncertainty
of those estimates is not shown. Marks on the axis: the estimates.
